name: Drywall and framing
description: Gypsum board partitions by height (8, 9, 10, 12 ft) and layers on steel or wood studs, wall linings, ceilings, corner bead and trim, exterior 2x6 walls and rough openings. Assemblies only: set your own rates.
author: CadCraft

sources.title: GA-216, Application and Finishing of Gypsum Panel Products
International Residential Code, Section R702 Interior Covering (gypsum board application, Table R702.3.5)
ASTM C754, Standard Specification for Installation of Steel Framing Members to Receive Screw-Attached Gypsum Panel Products
Plain geometry: the quantity follows from the measured length, height or area and the stated module (no outside source needed)
International Residential Code, Section R602 Wood Wall Framing
International Residential Code, Section R703 Exterior Covering (water-resistive barrier, siding attachment, anchored veneer ties)

assume: Studs at 16 in o.c.: ceil(0.75 x length) + one end stud per run; no extra studs for corners, intersections or openings (count those as rough openings).
Sheets: 4 x 8 ft (32 SF); the metric twin uses 1220 x 2440 mm (2.98 m²). Change the 32 / 2.98 for other sheet sizes.
Screws: 0.875 per SF of board on walls (28 per sheet: studs 16 in o.c., screws 16 in o.c.).
Tape: 0.375 LF per SF of finished board (12 LF of joint per 4 x 8 sheet).
Joint compound: 0.01 gal per SF of finished board — a starting figure; take the coverage from your product data sheet.
No deduction for openings: draw door and window openings as deducts on the run, or lower the waste.
